names.note: The nominative the day page's own `/name/14510.html` link carries in its `title` and as the heading of that page, «Михаил (Виноградов), иерей, сщмч.», with the two trailing rank words left off — `presbyter` and `hieromartyr` are in this folder's `types` and the office is the `Priest` the packs carry. The surname in parentheses is part of the name and stays, per BRIEF-RUSSIAN §2, which records that a bare forename here is something a reader reconstructs with less of the record in it; the day's own line gives only «Сщмч. Михаила пресвитера (1932).» `fk.mjs` on «Михаил (Виноградов)» returned NONE before the write, in a corpus already holding nine folders of the surname Виноградов and none of this forename.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of its line for 18 мая ст. ст.: «Сщмч. Михаила пресвитера (1932).» His name page gives no year at all, no year of birth and no place, and nothing was reckoned from anything.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 18 мая ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Михаила пресвитера (1932).»

attestations.note: **The line is all there is**, and that is a correct folder per BRIEF-RUSSIAN §2. The day page hangs no `/Life/` link on it; name page 14510 is a heading, «Михаил (Виноградов), иерей, сщмч.», and two days, «26 января (Новомуч.) , 18 мая», and nothing else at all — no paragraph, no icon, no article. The 26 января is the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia, a company's feast and not a second day of his own (BRIEF.md §8). The corpus holds nine other folders of this surname — Александр, Алексий, Василий, Иоанн, Мария, and three Николаи — and none of them is a Михаил and none stands on this day. azbyka.ru was not read, and it is the source that would turn this line into a life.
